items.title: Gaza war has undone 77 years of human development, UN warns
items.desc: The UN deputy chief urged renewed international support for a two-State solution to the Israel-Palestine conflict on Monday, warning that Palestinians continue to face violence, displacement and dire living conditions despite the October 2025 ceasefire in Gaza.

items.title: ‘We escaped with only our lives’: Fighting to give birth in war-torn Yemen
items.desc: When fighting suddenly escalated around Taiz, in southwestern Yemen two months ago, midwife Anisa Fadhl had no time to pack a bag before she fled, leaving behind her home and her clinic. Both were later looted and destroyed.

items.title: West Bank: Record settler attacks mar olive harvest as UN urges Israel to protect farmers
items.desc: Israeli settlers have carried out more than 400 attacks causing casualties or property damage during this year’s olive harvest in the occupied West Bank – more than in any previous season, UN agencies and humanitarian NGOs said on Friday.

items.title: Dozens more children killed in Yemen amid escalating hostilities
items.desc: The UN child rights agency, UNICEF, on Wednesday called for warring parties in Yemen to protect children as renewed conflict between Houthi rebels and Government forces approaches the three-month mark.

items.title: Lebanon leading the way in mental health support

items.title: Syria: Progress ‘real’ but fragile, as remnants of war wreck young lives
items.desc: Syria is showing “undeniable signs of progress” nearly two years after the fall of the Assad regime, but explosive ordnance, the approaching winter and severe funding shortfalls threaten those fragile gains, senior UN officials told the Security Council on Monday.

items.title: Security Council LIVE: Fragile Gulf calm tested as threats to Hormuz shipping mount
items.desc: Nearly nine months after Israeli and US strikes on Iran set off a regional war, the Gulf remains on a knife edge. items.title: Six killed in Israeli airstrike on Gaza’s Nasser Hospital
items.desc: An Israeli airstrike on Gaza’s Nasser Hospital on Wednesday night killed six people, injured 27 others and caused extensive damage.

items.title: Lebanon: Devastation awaits returnees as UN peacekeepers prepare exit
items.desc: The situation in southern Lebanon remains volatile and extremely difficult for communities trying to rebuild their lives, UN peacekeepers based there report, despite a significant decrease in hostilities following an agreement in June between the United States, Lebanon and Israel.

items.title: Syria’s undocumented children ‘pay the price’ of war and a law that shuts out mothers
items.desc: Many children born in Syria since the war began in 2011 have no legal identity because nationality passes only through fathers – many of whom are dead or missing – a member of the independent UN commission investigating rights violations in the country said on Wednesday.
